# Attraction is not returning

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`attraction-is-not-returning` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](attraction-is-not-returning.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Every determined law draws exactly what does not return; what can be had n steps on absorbs every lost possibility, and two merged configurations do not both return. Attraction is merging in finitely many configurations, not in an open world; entering an invariant region of a process locks in.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For a determined law next on configurations of any kind, a region is absorbing when it holds next s wherever it holds s; s is drawn into a region when s lies outside it and the course of s enters it at some step; s is drawn when some absorbing region draws it in; what lies ahead of s is its course from next s on. (`Becoming.Law.orbit`, `Becoming.Law.Absorbing`, `Becoming.Law.DrawnInto`, `Becoming.Law.Drawn`, `Becoming.Law.Ahead`)
2. What lies ahead is absorbing; once a course is in an absorbing region it is in it at every later step; a configuration returns exactly where it lies ahead of itself. (`Becoming.Law.absorbing_ahead`, `Becoming.Law.Absorbing.orbit`, `Becoming.Law.returns_iff_ahead`, `Becoming.Law.Returns`)
3. Lock-in: where a region is absorbing, s lies outside it and the course of s is in it at step n, the course is not s at any step from n on; so a drawn configuration never returns. (`Becoming.Law.DrawnInto.never_back`, `Becoming.Law.Drawn.not_returns`)
4. The main law, with no premise, no finiteness and no decidability: a configuration is drawn exactly where it does not return. One that does not return is drawn into what lies ahead of it, entering at the first step. (`Becoming.Law.drawn_iff_not_returns`, `Becoming.Law.drawnInto_ahead`)
5. The future narrows: what can be had n steps on is absorbing; a configuration that cannot be had n steps on is drawn into it, entering at step n, and so is drawn; what returns is absorbing. (`Becoming.Law.Reachable`, `Becoming.Law.reachable_absorbing`, `Becoming.Law.reachable_orbit`, `Becoming.Law.lost_drawn`, `Becoming.Law.drawn_of_lost`, `Becoming.Law.returning_absorbing`)
6. Merging: of two different configurations the law takes to one, not both return, with no finiteness, since two periods meet (a + (a + 1)·b = b + (b + 1)·a); so not both escape being drawn, and a law that merges draws something, both in double-negation form. Where nothing is drawn, two configurations taken to one are not apart, and with decidable equality the law merges nothing. (`Becoming.Law.Merges`, `Becoming.Law.periods_meet`, `Becoming.Law.Merges.not_both_return`, `Becoming.Law.merge_draws`, `Becoming.Law.Merges.draws`, `Becoming.Law.none_drawn_merges_nothing`, `Becoming.Law.none_drawn_lossless`)
7. Where a list holds every configuration, a drawn configuration rules out that the law merges nothing and that it keeps every possibility, and a law that merges nothing draws nothing; with decidable equality as well, the law merges nothing exactly where nothing is drawn. (`Becoming.Law.KeepsPossibilities`, `Becoming.Law.Drawn.not_lossless`, `Becoming.Law.Lossless.not_drawn`, `Becoming.Law.Drawn.not_keeps`, `Becoming.Law.lossless_iff_none_drawn`)
8. There, a configuration returns exactly where it can be had at every step, so it is drawn exactly where it cannot be had at every step (right to left with no list); every course enters a configuration that returns, so a configuration that does not return is drawn into what returns. (`Becoming.Law.returns_iff_always_reachable`, `Becoming.Law.drawn_iff_lost`, `Becoming.Law.enters_returning`, `Becoming.Law.drawnInto_returning`)
9. Open witnesses: under counting on, 0 is drawn and nothing merges; under counting down, 1 is drawn while every number can be had at every step. (`Becoming.Law.succ_drawn_lossless`, `Becoming.Law.pred_drawn_keeps`, `Becoming.Law.pred_orbit_zero`)
10. For processes: a region is absorbing under a determined law exactly where it is invariant under the law's process. A region is absorbing under a move when every step by that move from inside it stays inside; it is invariant exactly where it is absorbing under every move; from inside an invariant region, what lies outside it cannot be reached. (`Becoming.Law.process`, `Becoming.Law.absorbing_iff_invariant`, `Becoming.AbsorbingUnder`, `Becoming.invariant_iff_every_move`, `Becoming.Invariant`, `Becoming.Invariant.locks_out`, `Becoming.Reach`)
11. Along a run: from a step at which it is inside an invariant region, no later configuration is one at which it was outside; where every move from step n on keeps a region the run is in at step n, it stays in it; where it is inside at step n and outside at step n + 1, the move at step n does not keep the region. (`Becoming.Run.locked_in`, `Becoming.Run.stays`, `Becoming.Run.leaving_needs`)
12. In Ratchet every configuration goes to true: the law merges false and true, {true} is absorbing, false is drawn into it, never returns and cannot be had one step on, and true returns and is not drawn. (`Becoming.Ratchet.next`, `Becoming.Ratchet.atTrue`, `Becoming.Ratchet.merges`, `Becoming.Ratchet.absorbing`, `Becoming.Ratchet.false_drawn`, `Becoming.Ratchet.false_never_returns`, `Becoming.Ratchet.false_lost`, `Becoming.Ratchet.true_returns`, `Becoming.Ratchet.true_not_drawn`)
13. In Exit the move false keeps the configuration and the move true flips it: {true} is absorbing under false and not under true, so it is not invariant; the run that only moves false stays in {true}, and the run that leaves takes, at its first step, a move that does not keep {true}. (`Becoming.Exit.move`, `Becoming.Exit.process`, `Becoming.Exit.atTrue`, `Becoming.Exit.keeps`, `Becoming.Exit.leaves`, `Becoming.Exit.not_invariant`, `Becoming.Exit.staying`, `Becoming.Exit.locked_in`, `Becoming.Exit.leaving`, `Becoming.Exit.leaving_takes`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The main law and lock-in: any determined law next : S → S on a type of any kind; no premise about the law or the unfolding, no finiteness and no decidability.
- Finitely many configurations: a list holds every configuration (every : ∀ x, x ∈ all), written only into the laws that use it (Drawn.not_lossless, Lossless.not_drawn, Drawn.not_keeps, lossless_iff_none_drawn, returns_iff_always_reachable, drawn_iff_lost left to right, enters_returning, drawnInto_returning).
- Decidable equality (DecidableEq S) only in none_drawn_lossless and lossless_iff_none_drawn; which of two merged configurations is drawn is not chosen, and merge_draws and Merges.draws are double-negation forms only.
- For processes: any process P and region R; Run.stays has as its condition that every move the run takes from step n on keeps the region, written into the theorem.
- For the witnesses: Ratchet's law and Exit's process and runs.
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The main law is close to definitional: being drawn asks only for some absorbing region, and the region used is the configuration's own course ahead. Witness: `Becoming.Law.drawnInto_ahead`.
- It identifies lock-in with not returning and is not an attractor in the classical sense (attracting a neighbourhood, minimal, with a topology or measure). Witness: `Becoming.Law.Drawn`.
- The mathematics is reused: eventual periodicity on finite sets, and a map that is not injective having a point that is not periodic.
- The main law is stated here for determined laws only; for every process, necessarily drawn is not returning and possibly drawn allows return (necessarily-drawn-is-not-returning).
- Which regions actual unfoldings enter, and how deep or wide a basin is, lie outside the theorems.
- Escape from beyond the representation is not stated, a determined law having no move or exchange from beyond.
- The finite witnesses, Ratchet and Exit, have two configurations.
- The links to Capture, Admission and Becoming.Experiment are readings.
- **Counterexample:** An open world separates attraction from merging: counting on draws 0 and merges nothing (Law.succ_drawn_lossless), so Drawn.not_lossless, Lossless.not_drawn, lossless_iff_none_drawn and enters_returning need their list; counting down draws 1 while every number can be had at every step (Law.pred_drawn_keeps), so Drawn.not_keeps, drawn_iff_lost left to right and returns_iff_always_reachable right to left need their list. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Attraction.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A merge draws one of the two, not necessarily both: in Ratchet false and true merge, false is drawn and never returns, and true returns and is not drawn (Ratchet.false_never_returns, Ratchet.true_not_drawn). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Attraction.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A region every move taken keeps need not be invariant: in Exit, {true} is absorbing under the move false and the run that only moves false stays in it, while the move true leaves it (Exit.locked_in, Exit.not_invariant, Exit.leaving_takes). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Attraction.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren asked “hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?” and pasted an account of a general cause–effect system whose author is not stated (x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t, ε_t), feedback, adaptive parameters, path dependence, attractors; neither Ren's wording nor a premise). The AI compared and made five proposals, and Ren answered “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This is the fourth, “attractors and lock-in are merging”. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): an attractor is an absorbing region a configuration outside it enters, and its basin is what is drawn in; path dependence and lock-in are one law, what is drawn in never comes back; within finitely many configurations attraction and merging go together, while an open world can draw without merging; the future narrows, and read with Ren's “more future, not less” an attractor is the unfolding narrowing its own future; Capture's held rule is an absorbing region in the rule; the meta-attractor of winning, read as an absorbing region only a move not keeping it leaves, is the AI's reading and is not derived.

- **formal-reuse**: [recurrence-without-premise](recurrence-without-premise.md). Merging, returning and reachability are not redefined.
  - Output: The orbit, returning, reachability and merging of a determined law; within finitely many configurations, merging nothing is returning is keeping every possibility; a lost possibility stays lost; the spine's runs, reach and invariants.
  - Input: Absorbing regions, being drawn and lock-in; being drawn is not returning; within finitely many configurations attraction is merging; lock-in in an invariant region of a process.
  - Preserved conditions: A list holding every configuration, only in the laws that use it; decidable equality in two laws only. [Recurrence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Recurrence.lean)

Capture's held rule (P62, landing first) reads as an absorbing region in the rule: in Captured the configurations with a given rule form a region the law never leaves, and a reformed state is drawn into the configuration the rule holds at the first step; instance theorems for Law.Absorbing and Law.DrawnInto are not given (a reading, the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation).
- related, not a proved adapter: [endpoint-loss-and-return](endpoint-loss-and-return.md). Invariant.locks_out belongs with Recurrence's Reach.lost_stays to the persistence of loss along continuations; here the loss comes from entering an invariant region, and a drawn configuration not returning corresponds to loss without a return there. A conceptual link, not a proved conversion.
- related, not a proved adapter: [experiment-needs-return](experiment-needs-return.md). A drawn configuration never returns; there, what one's act would have done otherwise is fixed only where the configuration returns. The formal link needs being drawn for processes with moves, which is not stated (a reading).
- related, not a proved adapter: [four-cases-of-a-part](four-cases-of-a-part.md). There futures are compared by inclusion, widening and narrowing read as Ren's “more future, not less”; here what a law can have n steps on narrows, and lost possibilities are drawn in (a reading, the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation).
- related, not a proved adapter: [support-from-the-supported](support-from-the-supported.md). Admission's absorbing end (Flow.unsupported_stays) is, on flows and webs and under its premises, the absorption of the region in which no member is supported; instance theorems between the two representations are not given.
